name: Nafeesa Jones
summary: Nafeesa Jones - ready-to-play pre-generated investigator (Folly police officer and Newtonian apprentice).
notes: Imported from the Rivers of London rulebook, Appendix A: Ready-to-Play Investigators (printed p.343-349). Stat block reproduced for in-game use; backstory paraphrased. Unallocated pre-gen (scope []): a GM can assign it to a player to pick up and play.

sheet.name: Nafeesa Jones
sheet.backstory: A young Folly police officer and recent Newtonian apprentice who balances the job with being a wife and mother; grew up in Hammersmith, somewhat overshadowed by her evangelical-preacher mother.
sheet.reputation: Folly police officer and Newtonian apprentice
sheet.carry: Warrant card, mechanical watch, mobile phone, and a grab bag containing police notebook, pens, spare phone battery, Airwave radio, torch and spare batteries, Folly and Met forms, crime scene barrier tape, PPE pouch, waterproof clothes, snacks, bottled water, and Blackstone's Crime Investigators' Handbook.

signare.sound: Blackbird song and a tick-tock sound
